The '''Arporatal-Lanin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arporatal-Lanin]].
